subject: world_language
concept: Describing future plans and intentions with more detail than simple 'going to' statements
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'describe plans and arrangements' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student describes a multi-step future plan aloud in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences plan-step cards and narrates them with connecting words
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short paragraph describing a future plan with 2-3 connected steps

misconception_flags: uses disconnected simple sentences rather than a coherent multi-step plan

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
